cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Keep the spare cupboard key till tomorrow. Don't tell your flatmate I've left it here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me what's in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Could you accept knowing what isn't? Nothing alive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you collect it before she gets home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Text me when she leaves work. Just 'key', please.

mechanism: A grants limited information and authorizes a helper's deadline while securing secret key custody.
confusable: Unlike transparent delegation, A controls disclosure to obtain help before explaining the cupboard's risk.
comparison: A flatmate's return creates a negotiated limit, unlike Mum's unpacking and the envelope leaving home.
seedUse: Use spare key, unknown cupboard and collection deadline; make S01 clearance and approval shape the concealment bargain.
